answer_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS how_many_stores
FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON s.country_code = c.country_code
WHERE
  c.country_name = $country AND s.close_date IS NULL AND s.location_code <> -1

value.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS stores,
  COUNT(DISTINCT location_code) AS sites
FROM contoso_served.dim_store
WHERE
  close_date IS NULL AND location_code <> -1

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN sc.country_name = $country THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_store_country,
  SUM(CASE WHEN lc.country_name = $country THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_site_country,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (
        sc.country_name = $country
      ) <> (
        lc.country_name = $country
      )
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS routes_disagree
FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS sc
  ON s.country_code = sc.country_code
JOIN contoso_served.dim_location AS l
  ON s.location_code = l.location_code
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS lc
  ON l.country_code = lc.country_code
WHERE
  s.close_date IS NULL AND s.location_code <> -1

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS how_many_stores
FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON s.country_code = c.country_code
WHERE
  c.country_name = $country AND s.close_date IS NULL AND s.location_code <> -1

body.value: The query returned exactly one row, `how_many_stores = 8`: Contoso is still trading from 8 shops in Germany — German premises with no closing date recorded. WHAT IS NOT IN THAT 8: the 2 German premises that have closed (Germany carries 10 store rows in all, 2 of them with a close date), the web shop (not German — its country is the '--' sentinel), and every store in the other 7 countries. NO TIME RESTRICTION AND NO TIME DIMENSION: this is trading state as the store dimension currently stands, a snapshot, so it must not be read as "how many stores we had in year X". IT IS NARROWER THAN THE DECOMPOSITION'S `understood_as`, which assumed every store ever recorded in Germany open or closed; that reading gives 10, and a declaration — not a guess of mine — is why I did not take it.
